desc: Fix the syntax error in direction parsing and verify both public samples.
Validate the perturbation formula, including boundary contributions and suffix propagation to \((H,W)\).
Test zero values, revisited cells, repeated updates, and updates at boundary cells.
Prove the block algorithm’s correctness and total time/memory complexity.
Reject the current block implementation as too slow for maximum constraints.
Develop a substantially faster walk-aware dynamic algorithm.
Validate the improved algorithm against randomized brute force and both public samples.
Produce the final Python implementation only after complexity and correctness are established.
